definitions.gloss: carbonated water; sparkling water; soda water
definitions.explanation: Water that has been infused with carbon dioxide gas, creating bubbles. Widely available in Japan as a drink on its own or as a mixer.

examples.japanese: {炭酸水|たんさんすい}を{一本|いっぽん}ください。
{最近|さいきん}は{炭酸水|たんさんすい}がよく{売|う}れている。
examples.english: Sparkling water has been selling well lately.

examples.japanese: ウイスキーを{炭酸水|たんさんすい}で{割|わ}ると、ハイボールになる。
examples.english: When you mix whiskey with sparkling water, you get a highball.

notes:
USAGE:
A common everyday word. {炭酸水|たんさんすい} specifically refers to plain carbonated water without flavoring. Flavored carbonated drinks are called {炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炭酸水|たんさんすい}で{割|わ}る (to mix with sparkling water)
- {無糖|むとう}{炭酸水|たんさんすい} (unsweetened sparkling water)
- {強|つよ}{炭酸|たんさん} (strong carbonation)

FORMS:
{炭酸|たんさん} (carbonic acid) + {水|すい} (water).
